overviewHtml:
One shared channel for every issue buries the people who can act, and they still have to look up the relevant logs.

What you get

  • A trigger on matching Dynatrace events
  • A DQL query that fetches related logs
  • A lookup of the owning team through Dynatrace ownership
  • A Jira issue and a Slack message targeted at that team, enriched with log lines
prereqsHtml:
• Dynatrace SaaS with Workflows
  • Jira for Workflows and Slack for Workflows, each with a connection
  • Ownership teams assigned to your entities
  • Logs in Grail for the entities you monitor
setupHtml:
1. Download jira-slack-targeted-notifications.workflow.json.
  2. Import it in Workflows (upload the file) or with the Automation API.
  3. Select your Jira and Slack connections in the create_jira_issue and send_message_to_dyn_channel tasks.
  4. Activate the trigger.
getStartedHtml:
You need Dynatrace Workflows, Jira and Slack connections and ownership teams on your entities.

  1. Import the workflow in Workflows
  2. Select your Jira and Slack connections
  3. Activate the trigger
